result:
Both deliverables complete:

**Commit 1 — `2ee3390` perf(map): optimize FEMA property loading with tighter spatial filtering**
- Replaced bbox-only chunk overlap check with actual polygon point-in-ring test (5 sample points per chunk — center + 4 corners)
- Reduced FEMA chunk size from 0.2° to 0.1° for tighter spatial fit to swath boundaries
- Added `femaCountRef` to track FEMA count via O(1) ref instead of O(n) array filter on every load
- Switched swath property loading from O(n) array spread per batch to in-place push
- Increased FEMA debounce from 600ms to 1200ms to reduce thrashing during rapid pan/zoom
- Properly resets FEMA counter on cache clear and time range changes

**Commit 2 — `6f47649` docs: expand free data sources research with 11 new sources**
- Added 11 new detailed entries: US Census Geocoder (free geocoding), NOAA SWDI, OpenFEMA APIs, Iowa Mesonet, FEMA USA Structures, VIDA Combined Buildings, Sentinel-2 imagery, FEMA NFHL flood zones, NOAA Storm Events DB, OSM Overpass buildings, RentCast
- Updated competitor comparison with EagleView/RoofScope table
- Key insight: StormLeads already matches HailTrace on core data; main gaps are historical archive (SVRGIS, free) and lead scoring algorithm
